title: characteristic existence
semantics: Edges point to prerequisites; dependencies are conjunctive; one alternative route suffices. Reviewed source topology, not a kernel proof trace.
conventions: Carriers, hypotheses, quantifiers and constant scope are recorded per node and in the corresponding Lean declarations.

nodes.title: Backward characteristic of (5.1) through the terminal point (u₁, r₁) on [0, u₁] (IsCharacteristic)

edges.rationale: IsCharacteristic takes the proof hH of MemXBall u₀ x H as its argument and passes it to charField

nodes.source_hypotheses: u₀ ≥ 0; x a real number (no sign premise); H a continuous real function of (u,r) on [0,∞) × [0,∞) with a proof hH of MemXBall u₀ x H ; u₁ in [0,u₀] (u₁ : Icc 0 u₀, ); r₁ in [0,∞) (r₁ : ℝ≥0, ); χ a real function of real time
nodes.source_quantifiers: for each u₀ in [0,∞), for each real x, for each continuous H on [0,∞) × [0,∞) with a proof hH of MemXBall u₀ x H, for each u₁ in [0,u₀], for each r₁ in [0,∞), for each real function χ
nodes.source_conclusion: IsCharacteristic hH u₁ r₁ χ holds iff χ(u₁) = r₁ and, for every t in [0,u₁], χ has the derivative charField(t, χ(t)) at t within [0,u₁] (one-sided at both endpoints, ): χ is a characteristic of (5.1) dr/du = −½ḡ(u,r) through the terminal point (u₁, r₁) of the physical strip, on the time interval [0,u₁] (the backward characteristic of pp. 349-350 and 354-355, ), with the clamped coefficient charField = −½ḡ . Nothing is asserted outside [0,u₁]; for u₁ = 0 only χ(0) = r₁ is constrained (a within-derivative on a singleton is unconstrained, ). Forward characteristics χ(u; r₀) from u = 0 are not defined

edges.rationale: both premises; their first conjuncts give the common terminal value χ(u₁) = r₁ = ψ(u₁)

nodes.title: The canonical curve is a characteristic through (u₁, r₁) (isCharacteristic_characteristic)

Classical.choose_spec of that existence proof gives IsCharacteristic hH u₁ r₁ (curveExtension u₁ (Classical.choose …)), which is the goal after unfolding

nodes.source_conclusion: characteristic hH u₁ r₁ : ℝ → ℝ := curveExtension u₁ (characteristicOn hH u₁ r₁): equal to characteristicOn hH u₁ r₁ on [0,u₁], to its value at 0 for t ≤ 0 and to its value at u₁ for t ≥ u₁ . The values outside [0,u₁] are a formal device with no source content. This is the curve χ(u;r₁) through r = r₁ at u = u₁ of pp. 349-350 as a function of real time, with initial radius r₀ := χ(0)

nodes.title: The characteristic through (u₁, r₁) as a function on the time interval [0, u₁], chosen from the ∃! (characteristicOn)

edges.rationale: characteristicOn takes the proof hH of MemXBall u₀ x H as its argument and passes it to existsUnique_characteristicOn (hH is a binder of the reconstructed statement; is the target's own locator, the ball itself is item P.7.1/P.348.lemma1.ball)
the body is Classical.choose (existsUnique_characteristicOn hH u₁ r₁).exists; the definition is admitted only after this ∃! was sealed and audited , which makes the choice canonical
the predicate of the choice, and so the meaning of the chosen curve, is IsCharacteristic hH u₁ r₁ of its extension: the ODE and the terminal condition
the predicate of the choice is stated through curveExtension u₁ χ, which turns the curve on [0,u₁] into a function of real time

nodes.source_conclusion: characteristicOn hH u₁ r₁ : [0,u₁] → ℝ (a real function on the time subtype Icc 0 u₁) := Classical.choose of the existence part of the sealed existsUnique_characteristicOn hH u₁ r₁, i.e. the unique curve χ on [0,u₁] whose constant extension curveExtension u₁ χ is a characteristic through (u₁, r₁) (IsCharacteristic hH u₁ r₁). Because the witness is unique, the value does not depend on Lean's choice function ( choose-after-well-definedness, ). This is the characteristic χ(u;r₁) through r = r₁ at u = u₁ of pp. 349-350 on [0,u₁]; reconstructed as a function: [P] presupposes that the ODE and the terminal condition determine it

nodes.title: Constant extension of a curve on [0, u₁] to all real times by Set.projIcc (curveExtension, formal device )
nodes.source_hypotheses: u₀ ≥ 0; u₁ in [0,u₀] (u₁ : Icc 0 u₀); χ a real function on the time interval [0,u₁] (the subtype Icc 0 u₁); t real
nodes.source_quantifiers: for each u₀ in [0,∞), for each u₁ in [0,u₀], for each real function χ on [0,u₁], for each real t
nodes.source_conclusion: curveExtension u₁ χ (t) := χ(projIcc 0 u₁ t): equal to χ(0) for t ≤ 0, to χ(t) for t in [0,u₁] and to χ(u₁) for t ≥ u₁. A formal device with no source content : it turns a curve on the time interval into a function of real time, with no ODE content outside [0,u₁] and corners at the endpoints

nodes.title: Closed ball of radius x in the space X of (7.1) on the strip [0,u₀]×[0,∞) (MemXBall)
nodes.source_hypotheses: u₀ ≥ 0; x a real number (no sign premise); H is a continuous real function of (u,r) on the quadrant [0,∞) × [0,∞) (field carrier , reused), with slices H(u,·); values of H for u > u₀ are unconstrained
nodes.source_quantifiers: for each u₀ in [0,∞), for each real x, for each continuous H on [0,∞) × [0,∞)
nodes.source_conclusion: MemXBall u₀ x H holds iff (1) for every u in [0,∞) with u ≤ u₀ the slice lift s ↦ H(u, s⁺) is C¹ (ContDiffOn of order 1) on [0,∞), with the derivative at s = 0 one-sided within [0,∞) ; (2) the map (u,r) ↦ ∂_r H(u,r), the derivative within [0,∞) at r of the lift s ↦ H(u⁺, s⁺), is continuous on the closed strip [0,u₀] × [0,∞); (3) for every u ≤ u₀ and every r ≥ 0, (1+r)³ abs(H(u,r)) + (1+r)⁴ abs(∂_r H(u,r)) ≤ x. Fields (1)-(2) are "continuous and posess a continuous partial derivative with respect to r" of (7.1) (continuity of H itself is the carrier's); field (3) is ‖H‖_X ≤ x for the printed sum norm (7.1) (U-NORMS), i.e. membership in "the closed ball of radius x₁ in the space X" of Lemma 1 with x₁ = x . No evolution equation and no ∂_u H are assumed
nodes.constant_scope: the radius x is an explicit parameter of the predicate, not existential ; the double sup over u then r of (7.1) is replaced by the equivalent pointwise bound for all u ≤ u₀ and all r ≥ 0
